research_texts.q_45237:
*Spider-Man: Brand New Day* had a record-breaking domestic opening weekend, taking in $360 million from 4,487 North American theaters by Monday, August 3, 2026. This surpassed *Avengers: Endgame*'s previous domestic opening record of $357.1 million [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-opening-record-endgame-box-office-1236662986/) [yahoo.com](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/movies/articles/spider-man-brand-day-comes-191545224.html). The film also set records for the biggest Thursday previews and top Friday opening domestic sum [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-previews-opening-1236660645/).

As of August 2, 2026 (Day 4 of its release), the film's cumulative gross domestic total stood at $407,156,180 [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/date/2026-08-02/weekly/). On August 2 alone, *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* earned $47,064,608 [boxofficemojo.com](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/date/2026-08-02/weekly/). Its global weekend total for the opening was $932 million [hollywoodreporter.com](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-opening-record-endgame-box-office-1236662986/), with some reports indicating $930 million [yahoo.com](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/movies/articles/spider-man-brand-day-comes-191545224.html).
research_texts.q_45168:
Italy's suspension of Schengen rules for non-EU nationals arriving from Spain is set to continue until at least August 15, 2026, with an initial stated end date of August 31, and an option for renewal [brusselssignal.eu](https://brusselssignal.eu/2026/08/sanchez-turns-spains-border-controls-on-italy-rather-than-on-morocco/). Spain, in retaliation, implemented its own border checks on all travelers from Italy from August 8, 2026, until September 7, 2026 [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/ceuta-spain-warns-italy-it-will-reciprocate-entry-checks).

The dispute stems from a mass crossing of approximately 72,000 migrants into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta from Morocco around July 30-31, 2026 [euperspectives.eu](https://euperspectives.eu/2026/08/italy-tests-schengens-limits-over-migrants-who-never-reached-its-border/). Italy justified its checks under Article 25a of the Schengen Borders Code, citing an "unforeseeable, serious threat," a claim Spain disputes [euperspectives.eu](https://euperspectives.eu/2026/08/italy-tests-schengens-limits-over-migrants-who-never-reached-its-border/). Italy has stated it will not accept "ultimatums or impositions" from Madrid regarding its border controls [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/ceuta-spain-warns-italy-it-will-reciprocate-entry-checks/). Most migrants who entered Ceuta had returned to Morocco by July 31 [euperspectives.eu](https://euperspectives.eu/2026/08/italy-tests-schengens-limits-over-migrants-who-never-reached-its-border/).
research_texts.q_45070: Uber's takeover offer for Delivery Hero, announced on July 16, 2026, requires approval from BaFin (Germany's Federal Financial Supervisory Authority) for the offer document. Once approved, the acceptance period for the takeover offer will begin [investor.uber.com](https://investor.uber.com/news-events/news/press-release-details/2026/Uber-Announces-Acquisition-Offer-for-Delivery-Hero/default.aspx). The overall transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2027, indicating a potentially lengthy regulatory process beyond BaFin's initial approval [investor.uber.com](https://investor.uber.com/news-events/news/press-release-details/2026/Uber-Announces-Acquisition-Offer-for-Delivery-Hero/default.aspx), [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/business/uber-launches-148-billion-takeover-bid-delivery-hero-2026-07-16/). Analysts noted the "long timeline to completion" suggests a complex review [reuters.com](https://www.reuters.com/business/uber-launches-148-billion-takeover-bid-delivery-hero-2026-07-16/). While BaFin approval is a crucial initial step, the deal also requires merger control and financial regulatory clearances [investor.uber.com](https://investor.uber.com/news-events/news/press-release-details/2026/Uber-Announces-Acquisition-Offer-for-Delivery-Hero/default.aspx), [siliconcanals.com](https://siliconcanals.com/sc-n-ubers-14-8b-delivery-hero-bid-would-take-its-global-platform-to-99-markets/). The Business Combination Agreement includes termination fees, with a €700 million fee payable by Uber if the offer lapses due to regulatory approvals not being met by May 10, 2028 [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1543151/000155278126000382/e26302_uber-8k.htm). No specific dates regarding BaFin's expected decision on the offer document were provided.
research_texts.q_45068:
As of July 24, 2026, the Malian government has rejected reports of potential US military intervention against JNIM. Foreign Minister Abdoulaye Diop stated that Mali has received "absolutely no confirmation" from the United States and is not "sitting and waiting for others to come and solve our problem," emphasizing reliance on its own security forces and sovereignty [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/could-us-airstrikes-stop-insurgency-in-mali/a-78141641), [africanews.com](https://www.africanews.com/2026/07/24/malian-government-rejects-us-role-in-anti-jnim-fight/). Diop indicated that Mali learned of the potential US action only through press reports [africanews.com](https://www.africanews.com/2026/07/24/malian-government-rejects-us-role-in-anti-jnim-fight/).

US officials have confirmed that the Trump administration is weighing military options against JNIM, an al-Qaeda affiliate responsible for over 1,200 deaths in 2025 [seattletimes.com](https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/trump-administration-weighing-military-options-in-mali-officials-say/), [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/could-us-airstrikes-stop-insurgency-in-mali/a-78141641/). The administration's key aim has been to secure "overflight" rights in Mali [thehill.com](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5984194-trump-mulls-jnim-strikes/), partly driven by intelligence sharing that ramped up last year [seattletimes.com](https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/trump-administration-weighing-military-options-in-mali-officials-say/). However, there is disagreement among senior US officials regarding the use of force [seattletimes.com](https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/trump-administration-weighing-military-options-in-mali-officials-say/). Experts warn that airstrikes could backfire, potentially increasing civilian casualties, being exploited for JNIM propaganda, or leading to retaliation against Western interests [dw.com](https://www.dw.com/en/could-us-airstrikes-stop-insurgency-in-mali/a-78141641/), [seattletimes.com](https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/trump-administration-weighing-military-options-in-mali-officials-say/). Direct US military involvement also risks hostilities with Russian forces in the region [seattletimes.com](https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/trump-administration-weighing-military-options-in-mali-officials-say/).
research_texts.q_45066:
As of August 4, 2026, the CDC has reported 517 hospitalizations due to laboratory-confirmed domestically acquired cyclosporiasis since May 1, 2026. The 2026 cyclosporiasis season is from May 1 to August 31, and cases typically rise during the spring and summer months [cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/cyclosporiasis/php/surveillance/index.html).

There are two ongoing outbreaks:
*   **Multistate Outbreak (linked to iceberg lettuce):** This outbreak has resulted in at least 278 hospitalizations from 15 states, with illnesses beginning as early as June 22 and continuing through July 31, 2026. Two deaths have been reported in Michigan associated with this outbreak [cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/cyclosporiasis/outbreaks/07-26/investigation.html). Six additional states (Arkansas, Iowa, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, and North Carolina) were recently added to the initial nine (Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia) [nbcnews.com](https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/cyclospora-outbreak-cyclosporiasis-spread-states-cdc-rcna590836), [cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/cyclosporiasis/outbreaks/07-26/investigation.html).
*   **Taco Bell Outbreak (linked to iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms de Mexico):** This outbreak, as of August 5, 2026, has led to 94 hospitalizations across 5 states, with illness onset dates ranging from May 13 to July 13, 2026 [cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/cyclosporiasis/outbreaks/07-26/investigation.html).

The CDC anticipates case counts will continue to rise due to an estimated 6-week reporting lag between illness onset and reporting [cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/cyclosporiasis/php/surveillance/index.html).
research_texts.q_45063:
The 86th Annual Sturgis Motorcycle Rally is scheduled for August 7-16, 2026 [blackhillshotels.co](https://blackhillshotels.co/black-hills-summer-2026/). The South Dakota Department of Transportation (SDDOT) provides daily traffic counts at nine entry points to Sturgis to measure vehicle entries during the rally [dot.sd.gov](https://dot.sd.gov/transportation/highways/traffic-data/) [thedickinsonpress.com](https://www.thedickinsonpress.com/news/south-dakota/85th-sturgis-rally-on-track-for-a-5-year-high). While these counts don't represent individual visitors, they offer a reliable year-over-year indicator of activity [thedickinsonpress.com](https://www.thedickinsonpress.com/news/south-dakota/85th-sturgis-rally-on-track-for-a-5-year-high).

The 85th Rally in 2025 recorded 537,459 vehicles entering Sturgis over ten days, which was the highest total since 2015 [blackhillshotels.co](https://blackhillshotels.co/black-hills-summer-2026/). This reflects a trend of increased attendance in years ending in five and zero [thedickinsonpress.com](https://www.thedickinsonpress.com/news/south-dakota/85th-sturgis-rally-on-track-for-a-5-year-high). However, rally attendance and revenues traditionally soften in the year immediately following a major anniversary year (like 2026 after the 85th) [sturgis-sd.civicweb.net](https://sturgis-sd.civicweb.net/document/156689/Sturgis%20Rally%20Financial%20Overview%20%e2%80%93%202024,%202025,%20.pdf?handle=04AB154C33B14C928DBFAB209148040C). The city of Sturgis's preliminary forecast for 2026 anticipates this adjustment and includes targeted reductions in sponsorship-related expenditures to protect net proceeds [sturgis-sd.civicweb.net](https://sturgis-sd.civicweb.net/document/156689/Sturgis%20Rally%20Financial%20Overview%20%e2%80%93%202024,%202025,%20.pdf?handle=04AB154C33B14C928DBFAB209148040C). Despite this, the 86th Rally will be integrated into celebrations for America's 250th birthday, which may offer national marketing opportunities [sturgis-sd.civicweb.net](https://sturgis-sd.civicweb.net/document/156689/Sturgis%20Rally%20Financial%20Overview%20%e2%80%93%202024,%202025,%20.pdf?handle=04AB154C33B14C928DBFAB209148040C).
research_texts.q_44938:
As of August 7, 2026, the cumulative burnt area from forest fires in the EU for the year stands at 500,333 hectares (ha) [effis.emergency.copernicus.eu]. This figure is slightly lower than the 500,852 ha reported on August 6, 2026 [joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu]. This year's burnt area significantly exceeds the 381,444 ha recorded by the same date in 2025, which was previously the worst year on record, and is well above the 20-year long-term average (2006–2025) of 197,347 ha [joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu].

During the week leading up to August 7, 2026, 36,478 ha were burnt, which is a decrease from the previous week [effis.emergency.copernicus.eu]. The number of fires also decreased, with 81 fires mapped last week, down from the week before [effis.emergency.copernicus.eu]. The EU's cumulative burnt area as of July 29, 2026, was nearly 435,000 ha, making 2026 the second-worst year for wildfires by this time, after 2022 [carbonbrief.org]. Data on burnt areas and the number of fires are currently updated daily on working days due to the critical wildfire situation [joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu].
research_texts.q_44937:
The 2026 World Yo-Yo Contest (WYYC2026) will be held from August 13-16, 2026, in Himeji, Japan [worldyoyocontest.org](https://worldyoyocontest.org/faq/). Division 1A is one of the six championship divisions [worldyoyocontest.org](https://worldyoyocontest.org/faq/).

Mir Kim, a South Korean competitive yo-yo player, is the three-time reigning 1A World Champion, having won in 2023, 2024, and 2025 [yoyoarchive.org](https://yoyoarchive.org/profiles/mir-kim). He is sponsored by YoYoFactory and Sochi Company, and is known for his technically dense and clean freestyles [yoyoarchive.org](https://yoyoarchive.org/profiles/mir-kim). Kim co-designed the "Miracle" signature throw line with his sister, Miri Kim, a five-time Women's World Champion [yoyoarchive.org](https://yoyoarchive.org/profiles/mir-kim). He holds the record for the highest 1A freestyle score ever recorded, 99.7 out of 100, set at the 2023 WYYC in Osaka [yoyoarchive.org](https://yoyoarchive.org/profiles/mir-kim).

The registered contestant list for WYYC2026 was last updated on July 31, 2026 [worldyoyocontest.org](https://worldyoyocontest.org/).
research_texts.q_44830:
As of early August 2026, the number of trillion-dollar companies is a dynamic figure, with several firms hovering near the threshold.

According to data from August 3, 2026, [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/research/largest-companies-by-market-cap/) lists Eli Lilly (\$1.1 trillion), Berkshire Hathaway (\$1.1 trillion), and Samsung Electronics (market cap not specified but implied to be around \$1 trillion based on context) as members of the trillion-dollar club. SK Hynix, Micron Technology, and JPMorgan Chase are all valued below \$1 trillion, at \$1.0 trillion, \$991.1 billion, and \$958.0 billion respectively as of August 3, 2026 [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/research/largest-companies-by-market-cap/). Walmart and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) are also below this mark, at \$890.1 billion and \$789.1 billion, respectively [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/research/largest-companies-by-market-cap/).

Earlier, as of June 2026, one report stated that the U.S. "trillion-dollar club" expanded to 16 companies, with AI remaining a core driver of growth [tradingkey.com](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262007980-largest-company-us-stock-nvidia-google-apple-microsoft-amazon-2026-tradingkey). This report also noted that SpaceX joined the world's top 10 list after going public [tradingkey.com](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262007980-largest-company-us-stock-nvidia-google-apple-microsoft-amazon-2026-tradingkey).

Note: discarded the June 29, 2026 reference citing 12 trillion-dollar companies, as it contradicts the June 2026 report of 16 companies; the later, more specific date (June 29) cannot definitively resolve this without additional clarity on whether both sources are reliable.
research_texts.q_43924:
Between July 20 and September 1, 2026, the Russia-Ukraine war is likely to see continued large-scale Russian air attacks and ground offensives, met by Ukrainian long-range strikes.

In July 2026, Russia's long-range strike campaign against Ukrainian cities led to a record 293 civilian deaths and 1,990 injuries in June, the highest since April 2022, primarily from missile and long-range drone strikes [criticalthreats.org]. Ukrainian forces have continued their long-range strike campaign, hitting seven electrical substations in occupied Crimea on July 19-20, and a Wildberries warehouse and an oil depot in Moscow Oblast overnight [criticalthreats.org]. Ukrainian forces also struck three Russian oil tankers and four dry cargo ships in the Black and Azov seas overnight on July 19-20, bringing the total to 119 tankers in the Sea of Azov and 64 in the Black Sea between July 1 and 20 [criticalthreats.org].

By August 7, 2026, Russia dropped a record number of glide bombs on Ukraine, contributing to a reported 43,000 Russian casualties in July as its armies retreat [aljazeera.com]. Russian milbloggers refuted official statements that the M-14 Rostov-Crimea highway, a critical supply route, was secure, noting continued Ukrainian drone strikes [criticalthreats.org]. The Ukrainian SBU also reported over 100 successful drone strikes against strategic targets by August 4 [understandingwar.org].
